text:
anya (Content): OK folks, idea: run a 3-week micro-workshop series called "Studio Sprint" — 3 x 45m sessions: quick tutorial, hands-on refapp lab, and a benchmark walkthrough. Primary goal: repo stars + signups to hosted demo. Thoughts?
sam (DevRel): love it. I can own the hands-on lab (week 2). Suggest a small badge/mission: 'Completed Studio Sprint' so folks can show off.
paul (Growth): metrics we care about: repo clones, hosted demo plays, landing page conversion, and post-event trial requests. We'll track via UTM + webhook.
teri (Design): I'll prepare a set of social cards and a compact benchmark badge that shows "latency x cost" score. Need raw numbers by Monday to design variants.

anya (Content): I'll write three short tutorial posts (one per week) and one long-form launch post that ties the benchmarks to developer tradeoffs. Want the language to speak to builders, not just marketers.

otto (Analytics): I'll run a lightweight benchmark that measures p50/p95 and $/1M tokens across hosted/dedicated for a short prompt set. Will surface a tiny data viz and a CSV. ETA Mon EOD.

sam (DevRel): For the lab, we should provide: a sandbox GH repo, a codespace template, and a one-click hosted demo that seeds sample inputs. @eng-bot can you cut a codespace configuration?

eng-bot: codespace config created at .github/codespaces/devcontainer.json in branch studio-sprint-demo. Preview app deployed to https://play.redwood.ai/studio-sprint-preview. Docker image: ghcr.io/redwood/studio-sprint:demo-20260501

kaya (Community): I'll recruit 8 community champions to run the sprint live in their local meetups and share feedback. Can we prepare a 5-slide kit + sample tweet?

teri (Design): will add a 5-slide template and 3 tweet variants. also a 15s gif for social.

paul (Growth): Routing plan for inbound: landing page -> HubSpot list 'studio-sprint', tag 'champion' if they self-identify, and webhook to internal #marketing-inbound. High-intent flags: repo_clone+hosted_demo OR trial_request.

anya (Content): Example payload for our webhook (send to HubSpot + slack):
```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "name": "User Name",
  "company": "ACME Corp",
  "role": "ML Eng",
  "actions": ["landing_reg", "repo_clone"],
  "utm_campaign": "studio-sprint-apr",
  "badge_claimed": "true"
}
```

otto (Analytics): I'll enrich payloads with estimated_token_usage and p95_est_ms if they use the hosted demo. Also compute a 0-10 engagement_score. Rules: register=1, attend=3, demo_play=4, repo_clone=2, badge_claim=1.

ravi (Sales): add a company_tier and monthly_tokens_predicted field so AEs can prioritize. Low friction: send hot leads (score >=7) to #sales-inbound with contact + company size.

sam (DevRel): For workshop materials: small dataset + 3 reference prompts, plus a short script <10m> for the instructor. I'll draft and push to studio-sprint/docs/instructor.md.

eng-bot: instructor doc created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/studio-sprint/blob/studio-sprint-demo/docs/instructor.md

anya (Content): Publishing cadence: week 0 launch post (announce series + benchmark summary), week1 tutorial deep-dive, week2 lab recap + community highlights, week3 benchmark deep-dive + case study. Also short webinar (30m) on the benchmark week.

teri (Design): For the benchmark badge, two sizes: inline (card) and micro (README). I'll make an SVG + PNG pair. Need the official label text for the badge.

otto (Analytics): Propose label: "Studio Sprint score: latency x cost" with numeric score computed from normalized p95 and $/token. I'll publish an open CSV and a tiny JS snippet to embed.

paul (Growth): Promotion plan: organic social + targeted emails to OSS contributors + small paid budget for dev communities. Also seed with 5 influencers we know who run infra communities. kaya please coordinate.

kaya (Community): will ping the 5 and prep a slack DM template. Also will run an office hours AMA during week 2.

ravi (Sales): What about 1-click meetings? For hot leads >7, pop a calendar suggestion to schedule a 15m intro call. We should add a checkbox on the registration form to allow callback.

anya (Content): Copy notes: emphasize 'ship inference reliably' and 'cost tradeoffs explained', avoid hype. Include a mini-FAQ addressing 'how reproducible are your numbers?'.

sam (DevRel): Can we add a tiny GH Action that runs the benchmark snippet on PRs to the demo branch so contributors can reproduce numbers locally?

eng-bot: GH Action added: .github/workflows/benchmark.yml that runs on push to demo branch and outputs /artifacts/benchmark.csv.

paul (Growth): Quick checklist before launch: landing page live, repo + codespace + demo live, badge assets, webhook routing tested, benchmark CSV + visual, influencer outreach sent. Who can own final smoke test?

anya (Content): I'll run the smoke test Tue morning and report in this thread.

kaya (Community): I'll prep the meetup kit and schedule office hours.

paul (Growth): Great. Let's aim to announce date next Wed. Meeting recap: assign owners in Notion and sync Fri for final polish. :sparkles:
